notes.title: Upcoming Events for the summer!
notes.content:
Participate in WarBirds events this summer!

1.	Furball-O-Rama lasts through June 9th.
2.	June 23- M4 Tank Event
3.	July 14 – Dawn of Aces Event
4.	July 28 – Last Man Standing Event
5.	August – M4 Tank Event
6.	August 25 – Battle of Britain Fantasy Event

notes.title: WarBirds Dogfights Available Thursday, Jan 14, 2016
notes.content:
An updated and enlarged version of WarBirds is coming!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/433130/

[b]WarBirds Dogfights 2016[/b] includes an infinite variety of offline combats. Multiple friendly [i]and[/i] enemy AI aircraft help you become a highly skilled WarBirds pilot. In addition, the game includes virtually all the features that makes [b]WarBirds 2016[/b] an online hit.

Check out the original [b]WarBirds 2016[/b] here:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/365620
